info.title: protocross - ProtoCross compiler
info.description: The ProtoCross compiler. Write the business methods of your protobuf messages once, in a small language with defined, tested cross-language semantics, and generate them as C# and C++, with their tests.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Compile, and write the generated code (the default).

commands.name: test
commands.description: Build and run the generated tests in every backend, and judge them.

options.name: --proto_path
options.description:
Directory searched for imported .proto files.
May be repeated. Each source's directory is always searched.
A project's <ProtoPath> directories are searched first.

options.name: --out
options.description:
Output directory (default: generated).
Each backend writes to <dir>/<target>/.

options.name: --test-out
options.description:
Build the tests too, into this directory.
Each test backend writes to <dir>/<target>/.

options.name: --scaffold
options.description:
Also write the build file that builds and runs the
generated tests: a .csproj for csharp, a CMakeLists.txt
for cpp. Requires --test-out.

options.name: --csharp-target-framework
options.description:
The C# test project's framework, net8.0 or later
(default: net10.0).

options.name: --csharp-project-name
options.description: The C# test project's name (default: ProtoCrossTests).

options.name: --cpp-project-name
options.description: The CMake project's name (default: protocross_tests).

options.name: --cpp-target-prefix
options.description:
What begins each CMake target, followed by _ (default: none).
Each needs --scaffold, and stands over the project's <Scaffold>.

options.name: --target
options.description: Comma-separated targets: csharp, cpp (default: all).

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
policy (spec 10.4):

options.name: --config
options.description:
Use this protocross.config.xml instead of searching.
Not with a project, which names its own.

options.name: --no-config
options.description:
Ignore any config file and use the built-in defaults.
Not with a project.

options.name: --arithmetic-overflow
options.description: wrapping (default), checked, or saturating.

options.name: --override-config
options.description:
Let a policy flag win over a setting the config file
states. Without it, the conflict is an error: the file
is the project's answer and a flag is not.
With no --config or --no-config, protocross.config.xml is searched for in each
source file's directory and every directory above it, nearest first. Sources
compiled together must all find the same one. A project compiles under the file
its <Config> names, or else the nearest one at or above its own directory.
environment:
PROTOCROSS_PROTOC         Path to protoc. Otherwise PATH and the NuGet
Grpc.Tools package are searched.
